supporting_ids: s2:A hot-Jupiter progenitor on a super-eccentric retrograde orbit, 2024-07-17
rationale: The papers provide evidence of hot Jupiters and their progenitors on highly eccentric orbits, supporting the theory of high-eccentricity migration. However, they do not conclusively settle whether this is the typical migration path for most hot Jupiters. The question remains partially addressed with new evidence but not fully resolved.
